name: Buttermilk Road parking area below the main boulders
basis: MP Buttermilks Main: park at Peabody or Birthday lot ~3.5 mi down Buttermilk Rd; mapped lot 0.2 km from the area.

name: Central Gorge lot on Gorge Road, trail drops into gully
basis: Owens River Gorge MP Getting There lists lots at 3.3/4.8/6.4 mi on Gorge Rd; 4.8 mi lot serves Central Gorge; mapped entry named Central and Inner Gorge Parking.

name: Central Gorge lot on Gorge Road, trail drops into gully
basis: Owens River Gorge MP Getting There lists lots at 3.3/4.8/6.4 mi on Gorge Rd; mapped lot is named Central and Inner Gorge Parking, 1.1 km from Inner Gorge; trail along gorge bottom reaches all.

name: Lower Gorge parking on Gorge Road near the power plant
basis: Mapped lot named Lower Gorge Parking, 0.5 km from the crag; MP says access differs per section.

name: Pullout on Gorge Road above Sub Gorge
basis: Matched by position only (0.6 km from Sub Gorge); gorge-bottom trail reaches all sections.

name: Dirt lot across from Pine Creek Campground, start of Scheelite Canyon
basis: Pine Creek guide text: Scheelite Canyon parking is one of two dirt lots just across from the campground; matched by position (0.6 km).
